For hotel conversions in the **Caribbean and Latin America (CALA)**, owners typically consider the following collection or soft-brand families:

| Hotel company | Commonly considered brands | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **The Luxury Collection**, **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio** | Luxury through upper-upscale; particularly relevant for distinctive resorts, historic hotels and all-inclusive conversions. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **LXR Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection by Hilton**, **Tapestry Collection by Hilton** | LXR for luxury, Curio for upper-upscale/luxury lifestyle, and Tapestry for upscale hotels. Curio and Tapestry already have meaningful conversion activity in CALA. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/whats-new-at-hilton-in-2026?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt**, sometimes **Destination by Hyatt** | Unbound for distinctive upper-upscale/luxury properties; JdV for more approachable lifestyle hotels; Destination is most relevant to resort-oriented properties. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/news-releases?item=124064&utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection** | Luxury and lifestyle soft brand designed around independent conversions. **voco** is also frequently evaluated, although it is better described as a conversion-friendly hard brand rather than a pure collection. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery Collection**, **Handwritten Collection** | Emblems for luxury, MGallery for upper-upscale boutique hotels, and Handwritten for smaller or more cost-sensitive independent conversions. Accor is particularly relevant in South American markets. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Trademark Collection by Wyndham**, sometimes **Dolce Hotels and Resorts** | Registry for luxury resorts; Trademark for upper-midscale/upscale independents; Dolce for resort and meetings-oriented properties. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/convert-your-existing-hotel?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice Hotels** | **Ascend Hotel Collection** | Often considered for smaller upscale boutiques or secondary markets where conversion cost and operating flexibility are especially important. |
| **BWH Hotels** | **WorldHotels Luxury, Elite or Crafted Collection; BW Premier Collection** | Useful for independent luxury and upscale hotels seeking relatively flexible affiliation and international distribution. |
| **Radisson** | **Radisson Collection** or **Radisson Individuals**, subject to regional availability | Possible alternatives for upscale or upper-upscale conversions, though market coverage and corporate structure should be checked country by country. |

### Most common initial shortlist

For a typical upscale or upper-upscale CALA conversion, the first competitive set is usually:

- **Autograph Collection**
- **Tribute Portfolio**
- **Curio Collection**
- **Tapestry Collection**
- **The Unbound Collection**
- **Vignette Collection**
- **MGallery**
- **Trademark Collection**

For a true luxury resort, the shortlist generally shifts toward:

- **The Luxury Collection**
- **LXR Hotels & Resorts**
- **The Unbound Collection**
- **Vignette Collection**
- **Emblems Collection**
- **Registry Collection**

Owners may also evaluate **Preferred Hotels & Resorts, The Leading Hotels of the World, Small Luxury Hotels of the World, or Design Hotels**. These are generally membership, marketing and distribution affiliations—not conventional hotel franchises—so they offer more independence but typically less operating infrastructure.

The right shortlist ultimately depends on the hotel’s **ADR target, room count, resort versus urban orientation, all-inclusive model, renovation/PIP budget, owner-operated versus third-party-managed structure, and the brand’s territorial availability**. Hilton’s newer **Outset Collection** may eventually broaden the upscale conversion set, but as of 2026 it is much newer and less established in CALA than Curio or Tapestry. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/launch-of-outset-collection-by-hilton?utm_source=openai))
